title: Full-Set Planner And Transition QA

decisionGates.description: After generating transition preview WAVs and reports, stop for user listening verdict before rendering another full set.
After rendering a validated full set, stop for user verdict on transition quality, song ordering, wash-out frequency, and energy continuity.

subagentExecutionRules: Read this kiro.json, requirements.md, design.md, tasks.md, and all required steering context before executing tasks.
Do not change the accepted drop-switch or wash-out DSP formulas unless a task explicitly calls for a bug fix.
Use Rekordbox-labeled analyzed artifacts as semantic truth for this spec.
Use selected in-house key output and Camelot compatibility for drop-switch candidate gating.
Use SoundStretch only inside the configured tempo-stretch gate, and record every stretched placement in reports.
Generate preview WAVs before full-set WAVs so user review can catch bad transitions cheaply.
Fail planning or render preparation on state leaks, wet drop-switch FX, outgoing placement overruns, missing assets, or unsupported tempo plans.
Keep generated WAVs, reports, and local audition artifacts under ignored cache paths.
Stop at manual decision gates and record the user's verdict before marking those tasks complete.
